A '''cell block''' in the [[Carbonite Prisoner Storage]] section of the [[Minimum Security Section]], a sector of the [[Belsavis prison]] facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], was overrun by rioting [[Prison/Legends|prisoners]] during the [[invasion of Belsavis]] in the [[Galactic War]]. [[Cipher Nine]] freed [[Chaney Barrow]] and [[Kanjon Slyke]] from the cell block in order to recruit their help in breaking into [[Megasecurity Ward 23]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The overrun cell block appears as a subregion of the planet Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and is one of the two sites for the Imperial Agent mission "Breakout."<ref name="TOR" />
